caveats: Datasheet numbers are taken as authoritative because the 2026-11-01 bench test obtained no underwater thrust curve.
The flight controller only outputs 1100-1900 us (MOT_PWM_MIN/MAX), so the real vehicle reaches (400/500)^2 = 64% of these ratings. Treated as a deliberate protection margin, NOT modelled in sim.
Vendor titles containing BLUEROV are not genuine Blue Robotics hardware; do not substitute BlueRobotics curves.
Current telemetry read 0 A during the bench test, so the 300 W / 15 A figures are unverified.
Three thrusters share one model here; per-unit spread has not been measured.

model.equation: T_N = C * delta * |delta|, delta = (pwm_us - neutral_us) / span_us, clamped to [-1, 1]
model.rationale: Propeller thrust T = K_T*rho*n^2*D^4 scales with rpm^2; the ESC maps PWM approximately linearly onto rpm, so thrust is quadratic in the normalised pulse offset.
model.deadband_note: Bench observation: 1550 us (+0.10 delta) started every thruster, 1450 us (-0.10) started #1. True threshold is somewhere below 0.10 and unmeasured.

body_frame.convention: REP-103: +X forward, +Y left, +Z up; origin at the centre of mass

channel_mapping.note: Policy/action index -> flight-controller MAIN output, derived by matching the bench report's corner labels against the CAD thruster positions.
channel_mapping.source: ROV真机测试总结_20261101.md section 4 (MAIN1-8 -> Motor(2,1,4,3,6,5,8,7))
channel_mapping.verified: PWM request reached every MAIN channel on 2026-11-01 and the operator confirmed each thruster turned; blade pitch direction is still unverified.

confirms: MAIN1=front-left canted pushing forward+starboard, MAIN2=front-right canted pushing forward+port
MAIN3=rear-left canted pushing forward+port, MAIN4=rear-right canted pushing forward+starboard
MAIN5/7 on the port side (front/rear), MAIN6/8 on the starboard side (front/rear), prop disc horizontal
All 8 CAD positions and all 4 horizontal XY axes in this file match the diagram exactly

vertical_thrust_sign.implication: no sign flip needed; the TAM already authors +Z for V1..V4

still_open: As-built check that every propeller is installed as drawn: a single reversed blade inverts that one channel, and no drawing can guarantee the physical build

actuator_dynamics.note: No step-response data. The sim currently treats the command as instantaneous.

allocation_matrix.note: 6x8 body wrench per unit normalised thrust, W = B @ u, generated from the positions/axes above.
allocation_matrix.decoupling: Verticals span Fz/Mx/My, horizontals span Fx/Fy/Mz; cross terms are below 1.3 % of the diagonal.

refit_instructions: Provide a CSV with columns [pwm_us, direction, force_n, baseline_n, voltage_v, repeat] and the form above can be refitted; keep this file's structure and replace c_fwd_n / c_rev_n with the fitted values plus residuals.
